newsitem.title: UK: On Demand gains on share price statement.
newsitem.headline: On Demand gains on share price statement.

text.p: Shares in On Demand Information Plc bounced back on Monday from their steady decline since March after the Internet company said it knew of no reason behind the slump.
In a brief statement, On Demand said it "noticed the recent fall in its share price and wished to advise that they know of no reason why this should have occurred."
Shares in the company rose nine pence to 48-1/2p by 1230 GMT, after on Friday closing at their lowest level since the company was floated in December 1993.

On Demand issued a profit warning on October 8 which sent its shares plummeting more than 50 pence. It said it was launching a new Internet information service but acknowledged that hype surrounding Internet products was waning.
It also said an agreement with BT to provide sales and distribution services had been slower to produce results than both parties had expected.
